cases.description: An RFC 9068 access token with typ at+jwt is accepted.
typ id_token is rejected. Absent typ, JWT, and at+jwt are the only allowed type headers, compared case-sensitively.
A non-string typ is rejected. Only an absent typ, JWT, or at+jwt is allowed, so a number must not slip past a string-only type check.
A token that expired 30 seconds ago is accepted when clock skew is 60 seconds.
A token that expired 90 seconds ago is rejected when clock skew is 60 seconds.
A token whose nbf is 30 seconds in the future is accepted when clock skew is 60 seconds.
A kid that is absent from the JWKS is rejected. This fixture checks the verdict only. Each SDK also has a unit test that repeated requests for the same unknown kid do not each refetch JWKS.

A JWKS document larger than max_jwks_bytes (1 MiB) is rejected even though its keys array contains the signing key. Harnesses build the body as JSON with the fixture keys plus a pad string of pad_char repeated pad_count times, which makes the UTF-8 body exceed 1 MiB.
When tools:read and tools:write are both required, a token that includes only tools:read is rejected. Every listed scope is mandatory; one match out of two is not enough.
aud as a single string matches the configured audience.
aud as an array is accepted when it contains the configured audience.
